title: 隧道震波地質探測~Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation
focus: 分辨震波反射、速度模型與定位不確定性，將預測交由鑽孔驗證~Distinguish seismic reflections, velocity models and location uncertainty before borehole validation
summary: 本課聚焦分辨震波反射、速度模型與定位不確定性，將預測交由鑽孔驗證。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on distinguish seismic reflections, velocity models and location uncertainty before borehole validation. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 阻抗反差與反射~Impedance contrast and reflection
units.title: 阻抗反差與反射~Impedance contrast and reflection
units.mechanism: 反射源是密度與波速形成的阻抗差，並非岩性名稱本身。含水、裂隙和風化皆能改變波速，故同一振幅異常可以有不同地質成因，應保留極性與入射幾何。 假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。 若把反相一律當成含水斷層，低密度乾燥帶也會觸發誤判；若增益設定遺失，前後測次的振幅比較將無法支持地質變化結論。~Reflection arises from acoustic impedance contrast, not a rock name. Water, fractures and weathering can alter velocity, so an amplitude anomaly admits several geological explanations and must retain polarity and incidence geometry. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy. Calling every polarity reversal a water-bearing fault misclassifies dry low-density zones. Missing gain settings also invalidate amplitude comparisons between surveys and any inferred geological change.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy.
units.verify: 比對已知界面的波形極性、感測器方向及密度波速資料，並用探孔確認異常帶；振幅須先扣除幾何擴散與儀器增益，不能直接當成破碎程度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若把反相一律當成含水斷層，低密度乾燥帶也會觸發誤判；若增益設定遺失，前後測次的振幅比較將無法支持地質變化結論。~Compare polarity at a known interface, receiver orientation and density-velocity information, then verify anomalies with probing; remove geometric spreading and instrument gain before interpreting amplitude as damage. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Calling every polarity reversal a water-bearing fault misclassifies dry low-density zones. Missing gain settings also invalidate amplitude comparisons between surveys and any inferred geological change.
units.failure: 若把反相一律當成含水斷層，低密度乾燥帶也會觸發誤判；若增益設定遺失，前後測次的振幅比較將無法支持地質變化結論。~Calling every polarity reversal a water-bearing fault misclassifies dry low-density zones. Missing gain settings also invalidate amplitude comparisons between surveys and any inferred geological change.
units.misconception: 反射振幅只由岩石名稱決定，與密度及波速無關。~Reflection amplitude depends only on rock names, regardless of density and velocity.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄阻抗反差與反射的資料來源與適用條件。比對已知界面的波形極性、感測器方向及密度波速資料，並用探孔確認異常帶；振幅須先扣除幾何擴散與儀器增益，不能直接當成破碎程度。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for impedance contrast and reflection. Compare polarity at a known interface, receiver orientation and density-velocity information, then verify anomalies with probing; remove geometric spreading and instrument gain before interpreting amplitude as damage.

units.anchor: 走時與距離反演~Travel time and distance
units.title: 走時與距離反演~Travel time and distance
units.mechanism: 回波走時包含去程和回程，距離估算先依賴速度模型，再依賴反射方向。掌子面附近的低速擾動區可能加長走時，若全路徑仍採完整岩速度，異常距離會被高估。 假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。 錯把雙程走時當成單程會把距離放大兩倍；另一常見症狀是反射位置隨速度設定大量移動，卻在報告中仍只標出一條精確界線。~Echo time includes outward and return travel. Distance therefore depends on velocity and reflector direction. A damaged low-velocity zone near the face lengthens travel time, potentially overestimating distance when intact-rock velocity is used throughout. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m. Treating two-way time as one-way doubles distance. Another warning is a reflector moving substantially with velocity assumptions while the report still draws a single apparently precise boundary.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m.
units.verify: 先用已知源收距離的直達波估速，將不同速度假說的反射位置畫成區間；再對照探孔截交里程，確認不是斜側方界面被投影到正前方。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：錯把雙程走時當成單程會把距離放大兩倍；另一常見症狀是反射位置隨速度設定大量移動，卻在報告中仍只標出一條精確界線。~Estimate velocity from direct arrivals at surveyed offsets and plot reflector positions for alternative velocity hypotheses; compare probe intersections to exclude an oblique side reflector projected directly ahead. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating two-way time as one-way doubles distance. Another warning is a reflector moving substantially with velocity assumptions while the report still draws a single apparently precise boundary.
units.failure: 錯把雙程走時當成單程會把距離放大兩倍；另一常見症狀是反射位置隨速度設定大量移動，卻在報告中仍只標出一條精確界線。~Treating two-way time as one-way doubles distance. Another warning is a reflector moving substantially with velocity assumptions while the report still draws a single apparently precise boundary.
units.misconception: 反射走時乘波速就是距離，不必考慮去程回程。~Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄走時與距離反演的資料來源與適用條件。先用已知源收距離的直達波估速，將不同速度假說的反射位置畫成區間；再對照探孔截交里程，確認不是斜側方界面被投影到正前方。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for travel time and distance. Estimate velocity from direct arrivals at surveyed offsets and plot reflector positions for alternative velocity hypotheses; compare probe intersections to exclude an oblique side reflector projected directly ahead.

units.anchor: 頻率與分辨能力~Frequency and resolution
units.title: 頻率與分辨能力~Frequency and resolution
units.mechanism: 高頻提供較短波長，能分開更靠近的界面，但在破碎岩中也更快衰減。可探測距離與分辨率因此互相制約，取樣間距很密並不能補回地層已濾掉的高頻資訊。 假設v=4000 m/s、f=1000 Hz，波長λ=4 m，四分之一波長尺度約1 m；它是簡化分辨尺度非保證。 過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。~Higher frequency shortens wavelength and separates closer interfaces, but attenuates more strongly in fractured ground. Reach and resolution trade off, and dense sampling cannot restore high-frequency information already filtered by the rock mass. With assumed v=4000 m/s and f=1000 Hz, wavelength λ=4 m and a quarter-wavelength scale is about 1 m; this simplified scale is not a guarantee. Smoothing can merge two weak planes into one thick zone, while sharpening may manufacture interfaces. Estimating layer thickness from image appearance alone gives support design unjustified precision.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設v=4000 m/s、f=1000 Hz，波長λ=4 m，四分之一波長尺度約1 m；它是簡化分辨尺度非保證。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed v=4000 m/s and f=1000 Hz, wavelength λ=4 m and a quarter-wavelength scale is about 1 m; this simplified scale is not a guarantee.
units.verify: 檢視原始與處理後頻譜，分列可用頻帶和處理濾波器；以已知厚度的模型或合成波形檢查雙界面可辨性，避免把色階像素大小誤當地質分辨率。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。~Inspect raw and processed spectra and document bandwidth and filters; test separation of two interfaces with a known model or synthetic waveform rather than equating display pixel size with geological resolution. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Smoothing can merge two weak planes into one thick zone, while sharpening may manufacture interfaces. Estimating layer thickness from image appearance alone gives support design unjustified precision.
units.failure: 過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。~Smoothing can merge two weak planes into one thick zone, while sharpening may manufacture interfaces. Estimating layer thickness from image appearance alone gives support design unjustified precision.
units.misconception: 把顯示像素縮小就能提高地下薄層的實際分辨率。~Smaller display pixels increase the actual resolution of thin underground layers.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄頻率與分辨能力的資料來源與適用條件。檢視原始與處理後頻譜，分列可用頻帶和處理濾波器；以已知厚度的模型或合成波形檢查雙界面可辨性，避免把色階像素大小誤當地質分辨率。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for frequency and resolution. Inspect raw and processed spectra and document bandwidth and filters; test separation of two interfaces with a known model or synthetic waveform rather than equating display pixel size with geological resolution.

units.anchor: 取樣與時間混疊~Sampling and time aliasing
units.title: 取樣與時間混疊~Sampling and time aliasing
units.mechanism: 數位取樣須能追蹤欲保留的最高頻率，否則高頻會折回成假低頻。抗混疊濾波作用在取樣之前，事後再增加顯示點數只能插值，不能恢復已混疊的原始資訊。 假設取樣頻率8000 Hz，Nyquist頻率4000 Hz，時間間隔0.125 ms；保留頻帶仍須低於理想上界。 取樣不足造成的假頻率可能被誤判成岩體衰減，重取樣後曲線雖平順卻仍錯；若原始檔被覆寫，就無法判斷異常是地質還是記錄器產生。~Sampling must resolve the highest retained frequency or high-frequency energy folds into a false lower frequency. Anti-alias filtering acts before sampling; adding display points afterward only interpolates and cannot recover aliased information. At assumed sampling frequency 8000 Hz, the Nyquist frequency is 4000 Hz and interval 0.125 ms; the retained band must remain below the ideal boundary. Aliasing can masquerade as geological attenuation; resampling smooths the curve but does not correct it. Overwritten raw files prevent distinguishing ground behavior from an acquisition artifact.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設取樣頻率8000 Hz，Nyquist頻率4000 Hz，時間間隔0.125 ms；保留頻帶仍須低於理想上界。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed sampling frequency 8000 Hz, the Nyquist frequency is 4000 Hz and interval 0.125 ms; the retained band must remain below the ideal boundary.
units.verify: 核對記錄器原始取樣率、前置濾波與時鐘設定，用已知頻率訊號查核頻譜；處理者需保留未重取樣檔，並證明走時拾取在合理頻帶變更下仍穩定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：取樣不足造成的假頻率可能被誤判成岩體衰減，重取樣後曲線雖平順卻仍錯；若原始檔被覆寫，就無法判斷異常是地質還是記錄器產生。~Check native sample rate, front-end filters and clocks using a known-frequency signal; retain files before resampling and demonstrate that picked arrivals remain stable under reasonable changes of processing bandwidth. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Aliasing can masquerade as geological attenuation; resampling smooths the curve but does not correct it. Overwritten raw files prevent distinguishing ground behavior from an acquisition artifact.
units.failure: 取樣不足造成的假頻率可能被誤判成岩體衰減，重取樣後曲線雖平順卻仍錯；若原始檔被覆寫，就無法判斷異常是地質還是記錄器產生。~Aliasing can masquerade as geological attenuation; resampling smooths the curve but does not correct it. Overwritten raw files prevent distinguishing ground behavior from an acquisition artifact.
units.misconception: 取樣後再提高插值點數即可完全修復時間混疊。~Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄取樣與時間混疊的資料來源與適用條件。核對記錄器原始取樣率、前置濾波與時鐘設定，用已知頻率訊號查核頻譜；處理者需保留未重取樣檔，並證明走時拾取在合理頻帶變更下仍穩定。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for sampling and time aliasing. Check native sample rate, front-end filters and clocks using a known-frequency signal; retain files before resampling and demonstrate that picked arrivals remain stable under reasonable changes of processing bandwidth.

units.anchor: 疊加與相關雜訊~Stacking and correlated noise
units.title: 疊加與相關雜訊~Stacking and correlated noise
units.mechanism: 重複訊號相干相加，獨立零均值雜訊的標準差只按平方根增加，故疊加可改善訊雜比。持續機械振動若與測次同步，卻也會相干累積，不能用測次數保證品質。 假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。 把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。~Repeated signals add coherently while independent zero-mean noise grows only with the square root of count. Synchronous mechanical vibration also adds coherently, so record count alone cannot guarantee improved quality. Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB. Coherent machine noise can become a clearer false reflector after stacking while superficial quality indicators improve. Selecting only attractive records conceals instability and biases the final interpretation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB.
units.verify: 比較不同子集合的疊加結果及背景振動時段，量測噪音是否隨平方根縮減；若異常只在特定機具運轉時存在，需以獨立時段或替代量測驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。~Compare stacks from different subsets and background-vibration periods, testing whether noise follows square-root reduction; an anomaly tied to one operating machine requires an independent time window or alternative measurement. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Coherent machine noise can become a clearer false reflector after stacking while superficial quality indicators improve. Selecting only attractive records conceals instability and biases the final interpretation.
units.failure: 把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。~Coherent machine noise can become a clearer false reflector after stacking while superficial quality indicators improve. Selecting only attractive records conceals instability and biases the final interpretation.
units.misconception: 任何雜訊都會按疊加筆數的平方根規則消失。~Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄疊加與相關雜訊的資料來源與適用條件。比較不同子集合的疊加結果及背景振動時段，量測噪音是否隨平方根縮減；若異常只在特定機具運轉時存在，需以獨立時段或替代量測驗證。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for stacking and correlated noise. Compare stacks from different subsets and background-vibration periods, testing whether noise follows square-root reduction; an anomaly tied to one operating machine requires an independent time window or alternative measurement.

units.anchor: 測線幾何與偏移~Survey geometry and migration
units.title: 測線幾何與偏移~Survey geometry and migration
units.mechanism: 源收座標決定射線路徑與反射點，側壁布置的量測不一定正對前方。偏移成像把走時轉成空間位置時必須使用正確孔位和速度，否則側向地質可能被移到開挖軸線。 假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。 使用舊掌子面里程或錯誤側壁座標會使成像整體偏移；施工團隊可能提前或延後處理異常區，並錯把後來揭露的不一致歸因於地質不可預測。~Source and receiver coordinates govern ray paths and reflection points. Sidewall arrays do not necessarily look straight ahead. Migration needs correct geometry and velocity or lateral features may be moved onto the excavation axis. For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient. Old face chainage or incorrect sidewall coordinates shift the entire image. Responses may occur too early or late, with the discrepancy wrongly blamed on inherently unpredictable geology.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient.
units.verify: 用測量控制點核對源收三維位置，分別處理正前方與斜向的合成反射測試；將定位橢球與隧道斷面重疊，只有與開挖影響區相交的解釋才進入風險審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：使用舊掌子面里程或錯誤側壁座標會使成像整體偏移；施工團隊可能提前或延後處理異常區，並錯把後來揭露的不一致歸因於地質不可預測。~Survey three-dimensional source-receiver positions and test both frontal and oblique synthetic reflectors; overlay positional uncertainty on the tunnel section and review interpretations that intersect the excavation influence zone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Old face chainage or incorrect sidewall coordinates shift the entire image. Responses may occur too early or late, with the discrepancy wrongly blamed on inherently unpredictable geology.
units.failure: 使用舊掌子面里程或錯誤側壁座標會使成像整體偏移；施工團隊可能提前或延後處理異常區，並錯把後來揭露的不一致歸因於地質不可預測。~Old face chainage or incorrect sidewall coordinates shift the entire image. Responses may occur too early or late, with the discrepancy wrongly blamed on inherently unpredictable geology.
units.misconception: 側壁量到的所有反射都必定來自掌子面正前方。~All reflections measured at a sidewall must originate directly ahead of the face.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄測線幾何與偏移的資料來源與適用條件。用測量控制點核對源收三維位置，分別處理正前方與斜向的合成反射測試；將定位橢球與隧道斷面重疊，只有與開挖影響區相交的解釋才進入風險審查。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for survey geometry and migration. Survey three-dimensional source-receiver positions and test both frontal and oblique synthetic reflectors; overlay positional uncertainty on the tunnel section and review interpretations that intersect the excavation influence zone.

units.anchor: 波速與彈性假設~Velocity and elastic assumptions
units.title: 波速與彈性假設~Velocity and elastic assumptions
units.mechanism: 動態波速對應小應變快速載入，不能直接當成長時間靜態變形模數。裂隙閉合、飽和與各向異性使兩者差異更大，任何由波速推算的模數都必須保留密度和均質等向假設。 假設ρ=2500 kg/m³、Vs=2000 m/s，Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa；Vs增加10%使Gdyn增加21%。 把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。~Dynamic velocities describe small-strain rapid loading rather than long-term static stiffness. Crack closure, saturation and anisotropy increase the distinction. Moduli inferred from waves must retain density and homogeneous isotropic assumptions. For assumed ρ=2500 kg/m³ and Vs=2000 m/s, Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa; a 10% rise in Vs raises Gdyn by 21%. Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設ρ=2500 kg/m³、Vs=2000 m/s，Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa；Vs增加10%使Gdyn增加21%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed ρ=2500 kg/m³ and Vs=2000 m/s, Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa; a 10% rise in Vs raises Gdyn by 21%.
units.verify: 比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。~Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable.
units.failure: 把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。~Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable.
units.misconception: 波速推得的動態模數可以直接代表長期靜態變形。~A velocity-derived dynamic modulus directly represents long-term static deformation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄波速與彈性假設的資料來源與適用條件。比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for velocity and elastic assumptions. Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor.

units.anchor: 衰減與振幅混淆~Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity
units.title: 衰減與振幅混淆~Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity
units.mechanism: 振幅沿路徑受材料吸收、散射和幾何擴散共同減弱。接收器耦合不良也會降低振幅，因此衰減參數的反演需要校準源強與接收增益，不能只比較遠近兩個峰值。 假設純指數衰減A/A0=e^(−αx)，α=0.01 m⁻¹、x=50 m，比例e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607；未計擴散。 鬆動感測器可讓完好岩體看似強衰減帶，若再由此推測地下水會放大誤判；反之自動增益補償也可能掩蓋真實的遠距訊號衰減。~Amplitude decays through absorption, scattering and geometric spreading. Poor receiver coupling also reduces amplitude, so attenuation inversion requires source and receiver calibration rather than a comparison of two peaks alone. Assume purely exponential decay A/A0=e^(−αx), α=0.01 m⁻¹ and x=50 m. The ratio is e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607, excluding geometric spreading. A loose receiver can make intact rock resemble a strongly attenuating zone and encourage false groundwater inference; automatic gain correction can conversely conceal genuine attenuation at distance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設純指數衰減A/A0=e^(−αx)，α=0.01 m⁻¹、x=50 m，比例e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607；未計擴散。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume purely exponential decay A/A0=e^(−αx), α=0.01 m⁻¹ and x=50 m. The ratio is e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607, excluding geometric spreading.
units.verify: 檢查同一接收器的重複耦合測次並使用參考源強，分頻段比較衰減模型；將無法分離的吸收與散射列為聯合效應，只有附校準紀錄的振幅才參與地質對比。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：鬆動感測器可讓完好岩體看似強衰減帶，若再由此推測地下水會放大誤判；反之自動增益補償也可能掩蓋真實的遠距訊號衰減。~Repeat coupling checks for the same receiver with a reference source, comparing attenuation by frequency band; report inseparable absorption and scattering jointly and use only calibrated amplitudes in geological comparisons. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A loose receiver can make intact rock resemble a strongly attenuating zone and encourage false groundwater inference; automatic gain correction can conversely conceal genuine attenuation at distance.
units.failure: 鬆動感測器可讓完好岩體看似強衰減帶，若再由此推測地下水會放大誤判；反之自動增益補償也可能掩蓋真實的遠距訊號衰減。~A loose receiver can make intact rock resemble a strongly attenuating zone and encourage false groundwater inference; automatic gain correction can conversely conceal genuine attenuation at distance.
units.misconception: 只要遠處振幅較小就能證明前方存在含水破碎帶。~A smaller distant amplitude proves a water-bearing fractured zone lies ahead.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄衰減與振幅混淆的資料來源與適用條件。檢查同一接收器的重複耦合測次並使用參考源強，分頻段比較衰減模型；將無法分離的吸收與散射列為聯合效應，只有附校準紀錄的振幅才參與地質對比。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for attenuation and amplitude ambiguity. Repeat coupling checks for the same receiver with a reference source, comparing attenuation by frequency band; report inseparable absorption and scattering jointly and use only calibrated amplitudes in geological comparisons.

units.anchor: 走時誤差傳播~Travel-time uncertainty propagation
units.title: 走時誤差傳播~Travel-time uncertainty propagation
units.mechanism: 速度與走時各有不確定性，定位可信度由兩者共同控制。若速度來自同一批到時資料，誤差可能相關；平方和公式只適用獨立小誤差，不能把未知系統偏差包裝成高精度標準差。 假設d=80 m、速度標準不確定5%、走時2%，獨立時ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m。 忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。~Velocity and time jointly control location uncertainty. If velocity is estimated from the same arrivals, errors may correlate. Root-sum-square propagation applies only to small independent errors, not unidentified systematic bias. Assume d=80 m with independent relative standard uncertainties of 5% in velocity and 2% in time; ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m. Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設d=80 m、速度標準不確定5%、走時2%，獨立時ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume d=80 m with independent relative standard uncertainties of 5% in velocity and 2% in time; ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m.
units.verify: 由不同判讀者盲選到時，對照速度模型敏感度及儀器時間校準；報告分列隨機、系統與模型誤差，並用已知界面檢驗實際覆蓋率，而不把一個標準差當成確定界線。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。~Have independent interpreters pick arrivals blindly and compare velocity sensitivity with clock calibration; separate random, systematic and model errors and test coverage at known interfaces rather than treating one standard deviation as a definite boundary. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly.
units.failure: 忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。~Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly.
units.misconception: 走時拾取非常準確時，就可以忽略波速模型誤差。~Very precise arrival picking makes velocity-model uncertainty irrelevant to location.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄走時誤差傳播的資料來源與適用條件。由不同判讀者盲選到時，對照速度模型敏感度及儀器時間校準；報告分列隨機、系統與模型誤差，並用已知界面檢驗實際覆蓋率，而不把一個標準差當成確定界線。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for travel-time uncertainty propagation. Have independent interpreters pick arrivals blindly and compare velocity sensitivity with clock calibration; separate random, systematic and model errors and test coverage at known interfaces rather than treating one standard deviation as a definite boundary.

units.anchor: 預測與揭露對照~Prediction and exposure comparison
units.title: 預測與揭露對照~Prediction and exposure comparison
units.mechanism: 預測須在開挖揭露前固定版本，否則事後調整解釋會掩蓋漏判。判斷品質同時看成功預警與無異常區的錯警報，並把不可見範圍列出，不能讓彩色影像代替可核對的假說。 假設已知10個異常中預測8個，靈敏度80%；另有20個正常區錯報3個，假陽性率15%，兩指標分列。 僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。~Freeze predictions before excavation exposes the ground, or retrospective interpretation hides misses. Assess both successful warnings and false alarms in quiet zones and state blind areas; a colored image is not a testable hypothesis. If 8 of an assumed 10 anomalies are predicted, sensitivity is 80%; 3 false alarms among 20 normal intervals give 15% false-positive rate, reported separately. Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設已知10個異常中預測8個，靈敏度80%；另有20個正常區錯報3個，假陽性率15%，兩指標分列。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 anomalies are predicted, sensitivity is 80%; 3 false alarms among 20 normal intervals give 15% false-positive rate, reported separately.
units.verify: 用原始預測里程區間對照後續面誌與鑽孔，設定同一命中距離規則並保留未判定區；地質主管審查誤判原因是否來自覆蓋、處理或地質模型，才更新下一輪調查計畫。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。~Compare original prediction intervals with later face logs and boreholes using one predefined matching rule and retaining unclassified zones; the geology lead separates coverage, processing and model errors before updating investigation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification.
units.failure: 僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。~Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification.
units.misconception: 只統計成功預警案例就能完整評估探測可靠度。~Counting successful warning examples alone fully evaluates prediction reliability.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄預測與揭露對照的資料來源與適用條件。用原始預測里程區間對照後續面誌與鑽孔，設定同一命中距離規則並保留未判定區；地質主管審查誤判原因是否來自覆蓋、處理或地質模型，才更新下一輪調查計畫。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for prediction and exposure comparison. Compare original prediction intervals with later face logs and boreholes using one predefined matching rule and retaining unclassified zones; the geology lead separates coverage, processing and model errors before updating investigation.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示分辨震波反射、速度模型與定位不確定性，將預測交由鑽孔驗證需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why distinguish seismic reflections, velocity models and location uncertainty before borehole validation requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy.

教學量化備忘：假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m.

教學量化備忘：假設v=4000 m/s、f=1000 Hz，波長λ=4 m，四分之一波長尺度約1 m；它是簡化分辨尺度非保證。~Teaching quantitative note: With assumed v=4000 m/s and f=1000 Hz, wavelength λ=4 m and a quarter-wavelength scale is about 1 m; this simplified scale is not a guarantee.

教學量化備忘：假設取樣頻率8000 Hz，Nyquist頻率4000 Hz，時間間隔0.125 ms；保留頻帶仍須低於理想上界。~Teaching quantitative note: At assumed sampling frequency 8000 Hz, the Nyquist frequency is 4000 Hz and interval 0.125 ms; the retained band must remain below the ideal boundary.

教學量化備忘：假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。~Teaching quantitative note: Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB.

教學量化備忘：假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient.
